name: AIENG Replacement Branch Authored Validation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - automation/aieng-replacement-validation-20260907
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/aieng-replacement-validation.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout reconciled authored result
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: 605b8b860120c2012b619f34b1eb9638f7b5bc74

      - name: Verify authored-only branch boundary
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          base=15ddd23626be8045d30cf3a7fa35cd2ba9a694f3
          changed="$(git diff --name-only "$base"..HEAD)"
          prohibited="$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(\.eos/events\.jsonl|\.eos/evidence\.tsv|\.eos/evidence-links\.tsv|\.eos/maintenance\.tsv|\.eos/state/current\.json|\.eos/state/projections\.json|\.eos/trace-edges\.tsv|\.eos/evidence/|engineering/evidence/|machine/)' || true)"
          if [[ -n "$prohibited" ]]; then
            echo "integration-sensitive files changed relative to original main-line fork:" >&2
            printf '%s\n' "$prohibited" >&2
            exit 51
          fi
          if ! git diff --quiet "$base"..HEAD -- tools/eos/verification_v2.py; then
            echo "modern verification_v2.py facade was modified" >&2
            exit 52
          fi
          echo "authored-only replacement boundary: PASS"
          echo "modern verification_v2.py facade preserved: PASS"

      - name: Static validation
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git diff --check 15ddd23626be8045d30cf3a7fa35cd2ba9a694f3..HEAD
          bash -n scripts/eos
          python3 -m py_compile \
            scripts/reconcile-eos-canonical-state.py \
            tools/eos/canonical_state.py \
            tools/eos/eos.py \
            tools/eos/event_ledger.py \
            tools/eos/execution_v2.py \
            tools/eos/identity_families.py \
            tools/eos/verification_v2.py \
            tools/eos/verification_v2_impl.py \
            tools/eos/test_canonical_state.py \
            tools/eos/test_canonical_reconciliation.py \
            tools/eos/test_event_ledger_merge.py \
            tools/eos/test_identifier_families.py \
            tools/eos/test_wrapper_dispatch.py

      - name: Run authored regressions
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 tools/eos/test_identifier_families.py
          python3 tools/eos/test_event_ledger_merge.py
          python3 tools/eos/test_canonical_state.py
          python3 tools/eos/test_canonical_reconciliation.py
          python3 tools/eos/test_wrapper_dispatch.py

      - name: Verify no validation churn
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]]; then
            echo "validation mutated working tree:" >&2
            git status --short >&2
            exit 53
          fi
          echo "validation working tree remains clean: PASS"
